text: Explain why a ceramic mug feels cooler than a wooden spoon in the same kitchen, using everyday language.
Write a warm scene about neighbors repairing a bicycle together on a rainy afternoon.
Implement a Python function that merges overlapping appointment intervals, with tests for empty input and touching intervals. Explain the invariant.
Design a small TypeScript queue with cancellation tokens. Show how a caller enqueues a job and cancels it before execution.
Derive a formula for the sum of the first n odd positive integers. Give both an algebraic proof and a geometric explanation.
A bag contains four green and five yellow counters. Two counters are drawn without replacement. Calculate the probability of matching colors and explain each step.
Escribe una guía breve para organizar un intercambio de libros en un barrio. Incluye una invitación amable y consejos prácticos.
Expliquez en français comment préparer une randonnée d'une journée avec des débutants. Donnez un itinéraire raisonnable et une liste de matériel.
